value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER or call 911. Trouble waking, sunken eyes, and no wet diaper in 12 hours are signs of severe dehydration in a toddler.
value.triage: Do not wait - go to the ER now or call 911 immediately. This is not a call-811 situation right now given how hard she is to wake.
sources: CDC - Diarrhea and Dehydration in Children
